plugin.name: Aardwolf_Direction_Interceptor
plugin.purpose: Intercepts direction commands to use mapper cexits if they exist

muclient.script:
local sqlite3 = require "sqlite3"
local db = nil local current_room = nil local mapper_id = "b6eae87ccedd84f510b74714" local gmcp_handler_id = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
local short_to_long = { n = "north", s = "south", e = "east", w = "west", u = "up", d = "down" } local long_to_short = { north = "n", south = "s", east = "e", west = "w", up = "u", down = "d" }
function OnPluginInstall() Note("Direction Interceptor installed. Intercepting n, s, e, w, u, d...") open_db() end
function open_db() local db_name = GetPluginVariable(mapper_id, "db_name") if not db_name or db_name == "" then -- Mapper might not be initialized yet, try again in a bit DoAfterSpecial(2, 'open_db()', 12) return end
local db_path = GetInfo(66) .. db_name .. ".db" if db then if db:isopen() then db:close() end end
local err db, err = sqlite3.open(db_path) if not db then Note("Direction Interceptor: Could not open database: " .. tostring(err)) end end
local function parse_gmcp_data(gmcparg) if not gmcparg or gmcparg == "" or gmcparg == '""' then return nil end local f, err = loadstring("return " .. gmcparg) if f then local ok, result = pcall(f) if ok then return result else Note("Direction Interceptor Debug: Execution error parsing GMCP: " .. tostring(result)) end else Note("Direction Interceptor Debug: Syntax error parsing GMCP: " .. tostring(err)) end return nil end
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, name, text) if id == gmcp_handler_id then -- GMCP handler if text == "room.info" or text == "room" then local res, gmcparg = CallPlugin(gmcp_handler_id, "gmcpdata_as_string", text) if res == 0 then local room_data = parse_gmcp_data(gmcparg) if room_data and room_data.num then current_room = tostring(room_data.num) -- Note("Direction Interceptor Debug: Room updated to: " .. current_room) end end end end end
function fixsql (s) if s then return "'" .. (string.gsub (s, "'", "''")) .. "'" else return "NULL" end end
function get_current_room() local res, gmcparg = CallPlugin(gmcp_handler_id, "gmcpdata_as_string", "room.info") if res == 0 then local room_data = parse_gmcp_data(gmcparg) if room_data and room_data.num then return tostring(room_data.num) end end return nil end
local is_intercepting = false
function check_direction(dir_input) local dir = dir_input:lower() local short_dir = long_to_short[dir] or dir local long_dir = short_to_long[dir] or dir
-- Re-entrancy guard: If we are already in the middle of a mapper goto call, -- don't intercept again. This allows the mapper's own movements to pass through. if is_intercepting then Send(dir_input) return end
-- If we don't know where we are, try to fetch it now if not current_room then current_room = get_current_room() end
if not current_room then Send(dir_input) return end
-- Ensure DB is open if not db or not db:isopen() then open_db() if not db or not db:isopen() then Send(dir_input) return end end
-- 1. Find the destination for the normal direction ('n', 's', etc.) local dest_uid = nil local query = string.format("SELECT touid FROM exits WHERE fromuid = %s AND dir = %s", fixsql(current_room), fixsql(short_dir))
for row in db:nrows(query) do dest_uid = row.touid end
if not dest_uid then Send(dir_input) return end
-- 2. Check if there is a cexit to that same destination matching the pattern -- Pattern: "open n;n" or "open north;north" (supporting both ; and ;; separators) local found_cexit = false local patterns = { "open " .. short_dir .. ";" .. short_dir, "open " .. long_dir .. ";" .. long_dir }
local q2 = string.format("SELECT dir FROM exits WHERE fromuid = %s AND touid = %s", fixsql(current_room), fixsql(dest_uid)) for row in db:nrows(q2) do local exit_dir = row.dir:lower() for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do if exit_dir == p then found_cexit = true break end end if found_cexit then break end end
if found_cexit then is_intercepting = true Execute("mapper goto " .. dest_uid) is_intercepting = false else Send(dir_input) end end
